connector.name: Comfyui MCP by miller-joe
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for ComfyUI: text-to-image, variations, img2img refine, upscale, image proxy.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package comfyui-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the miller-joe account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: COMFYUI_URL
env.description: ComfyUI HTTP URL used internally by this server. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8188

env.name: COMFYUI_PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Externally-reachable ComfyUI URL used in image URLs returned to clients. Set when the internal URL isn't reachable from MCP clients (common with Docker networks).
